objective: Train the frozen V9 shared Q/O content gates to prefer row-correct or absent state over a different-gold length-matched donor state, breaking the generic-state shortcut while improving native scene-boundary F1.

training_data.donor_rule: For each row, choose a different-assistant-gold row minimizing absolute system/user write-token difference, then donor row SHA-256, then source ordinal.
training_data.schedule_rule: Sort eligible rows by SHA-256('rwkv-ms-native-scene-contrast-train-v1:' + row SHA-256), take the first 256, and group consecutive eights into 32 updates.

positive_conditions.correct_state: Write the target system/user prefix, disable writes, then teacher-force the target full row.
positive_conditions.no_state: Reset state, keep writes disabled, then teacher-force the target full row.

intervention.negative_condition: Write the matched donor system/user prefix, disable writes, then teacher-force the target full row.
intervention.state_dropout_rule: Within each update, rank its eight targets by SHA-256('rwkv-ms-native-scene-state-drop-v1:' + step + ':' + row SHA-256); the first two use no_state and the remaining six use correct_state.
intervention.loss: Mean positive target-token CE plus 0.25 times max(0, 0.05 + positive mean CE - donor mean CE), averaged equally over the eight global rows.
intervention.hinge_activity_decision: Compute detached positive and donor CE with sequential no-grad passes, then execute equivalent sequential signed backward coefficients without retaining two full-vocabulary graphs.

preflight.stopping_rule: Commit and push a passing preflight before launching all 32 updates.

selection_probe.source: The already-open effective-strength fit partition of publisher-TRAIN-derived scene development; do not use its sealed 73-row holdout.
selection_probe.selection_rule: Among source indices >=4 assigned to the effective-strength fit partition, sort by SHA-256('rwkv-ms-contrast-probe-v1:' + row SHA-256) and take the first 64.
selection_probe.ordering: correct-state micro-F1 descending, correct-minus-donor micro-F1 descending, correct-minus-zero micro-F1 descending, earlier checkpoint

progression.full_scene_development: Only a passing 64-row checkpoint may be evaluated on the remaining already-open effective-strength fit rows.
progression.multitask_preservation: Before any fresh publisher-validation replication, the selected adapter must preserve attribution and narrative on publisher-TRAIN-derived development probes.
progression.publisher_validation: Requires a new preregistered replication protocol and cannot alter the accepted decoder retroactively.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push preflight, training, and selection-probe outcomes whether pass or fail. Never inspect publisher validation predictions, publisher test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.
